description: Tuned C++17 integer online context arithmetic prototype. Builds qm_context_codec_v1.cpp with QM_TABLE_BITS=24 and QM_MIX_PROFILE=2 to expand the direct context table and reduce the untrained SSM path's influence.
notes: Same synchronized byte-canonical arithmetic stream as v1.
This tests whether the standalone integer architecture improves when the random fixed-point SSM is gated down and local collision pressure is reduced.
verdict: Reject. Larger local table plus weaker untrained SSM profile destabilized the adaptive mixer and regressed sharply versus v1.
